reader.requirement: At --std 85 literal-1 and literal-2 of MULTIPLY must be numeric literals; a nonnumeric literal or any figurative constant other than ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES, with or without ALL at 85, §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.1) is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: ConstructRegistry figurative-all-zero-numeric-removed-2002: ALL ZERO as a numeric literal admitted at 85, COBOL0902 from 2002
X".." and N".." literals require 2002 (COBOL0900); they are also refused here as nonnumeric (COBOL0844)

reader.edition-search: Read NumLiteral -> NonNumericInNumericContext -> ZeroOperand; the only edition consult is the ALL ZERO construct gate; grepped for DialectLevel/ConstructRegistry in ExpressionBinder.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: MULTIPLY ALL ZERO BY N is legal at 85 (ALL before a figurative constant is redundant, 1985 SRL3.1 bars only non-ZERO figuratives) and refused from 2002 (COBOL0902); the 85 arm admits it, as the 1985 text requires
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover alphanumeric literals as literal-1; not exercised are figurative constants (SPACE, HIGH-VALUE, QUOTE, LOW-VALUES, ALL literal), ZERO/ALL ZERO, Format-2 literal-2, and signed/decimal numeric literals

probes.printed: COBOL0844 on "12" (literal-1), SPACE, HIGH-VALUE, "3" (Format-2 literal-2), ALL "1", QUOTE, LOW-VALUES; MULTIPLY 2 BY 3 GIVING N3 accepted
probes.expected: every nonnumeric literal and non-ZERO figurative refused; two numeric literals in Format 2 accepted

probes.printed: D 0000 (MULTIPLY ZERO BY N4), E 0000 (MULTIPLY ALL ZERO BY N5), B -003.75 (2.5 literal), I -006.00 (-2 BY 3 GIVING)
probes.expected: ZERO and ALL ZERO legal at 85 and value 0; signed and decimal numeric literals legal

probes.printed: --std 2023: COBOL0902 ALL ZERO removed in COBOL-2002
probes.expected: later edition refuses what 85 admits (edition arm visible)

probes.printed: --std 85: COBOL0844 + COBOL0900 for X"31" and N"1"
probes.expected: post-85 literal forms refused at 85 and not numeric in any case

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.20.3 SR2  (6.20.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2
OK  §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.1  (4.2.2.2.3 Figurative Constant Values)  the text is in SRL3.1

reader.notes: One nonnumeric-literal reading serves every arithmetic operand; at 85 it admits ZERO and ALL ZERO and refuses every other figurative and nonnumeric literal. The COBOL0902 text at 2023 cites '§1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SR1', which cite.py says is SRL3.1 (a citation slip in a 2002+ diagnostic, not this rule's behaviour).

refuter.evidence: rm2lit at --std 85: symbolic-character SYM-ONE as literal-1 and Format-2 literal-2, ALL SYM-ONE, ALL SPACES, ALL QUOTES, ALL HIGH-VALUES all refused COBOL0844; the 2002 forms 1.5E2 (floating-point literal), "1" & "2" (concatenation) and B"1" (boolean) refused with COBOL0900 (and COBOL0844). rm2pos: MULTIPLY ZEROES BY ZEROS GIVING N1 -> A 0000; MULTIPLY 7 BY ALL ZEROES -> B +0000.00 (ALL redundant before a figurative other than ALL literal, §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.3 reading); +.5 BY -4 -> C -0002.00; 18-digit literal BY 0 -> D 0000. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.20.3 SR2 the text is in SR2; OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.2.3 SRL3.1 the text is in SRL3.1 ('the only figurative constant permitted is ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES)').
